subject: Portal evidence onboarding — responsibility & refresh SLA
messages:
From: Leah Park <leah.park@acme-payments.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-payments.com
Cc: security-portal@acme-payments.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding request: Vendr/Whistic + evidence responsibilities

Hi Vanessa,

We're starting the security intake for Redwood as part of our procurement checklist. Our security ops team prefers onboarding vendors into Vendr but we can accept Whistic if needed. Before we create the portal record we need: a) confirmation of which portal you prefer, b) a short responsibility matrix that says who at Redwood will own SOC 2 reports, CAIQ/SIG answers, and operational proofs (log retention, KMS screenshots, ephemeral token rotation), and c) the cadence you expect for evidence refresh (SOC 2 cadence vs operational artifact cadence).

Could you also confirm how Redwood prefers to be invited (email address for the portal admin) and whether you can provide a time-limited upload link for large artifacts (SOC2 bundle, syslog extracts) or if you prefer S3 presigned uploads?

We'd like to get this live in Vendr by the end of the month if possible — procurement is aligned but needs this scope clarified to finalize the PO.

Thanks,
Leah Park
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments
[Attachment: acme_portal_onboarding_template.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding request: Vendr/Whistic + evidence responsibilities

Leah —

Thanks for the clear ask. Vendr works best for us (we have an existing connector and a short onboarding flow there). High-level answers below, and I've attached a first-pass responsibility matrix and our onboarding instructions.

1) Portal: Vendr (preferred). Invite: vendor-admin@redwood.com. We will create a dedicated service account if Vendr requires one.

2) Responsibility matrix (attached "responsibility_matrix_v1.csv"):
  - SOC 2 report (attestation PDF): Security (Redwood InfoSec) — they own redaction and upload.
  - CAIQ / SIG answers: split — Security will respond to control intent and evidence mapping; Platform (Infra) will provide operational proofs (network diagrams, HW inventory, KV rotation screenshots).
  - Operational artifacts (logs, syslog extracts, KMS proofs): Platform provides the artifacts; Security validates and signs off.
  - Evidence retention / access logs: Security owns export for audits.

3) Cadence / SLAs:
  - SOC 2: annual (we provide the latest report within 5 business days of request).
  - Continuous operational proofs (log snapshots, rotation artifacts): we propose a 90-day refresh window for items that materially change; otherwise, 12-month passive affirmation.

4) Uploads: We prefer S3 presigned uploads for large bundles (SOC2) and will provide a 72-hour presigned URL. For small docs Vanguard (Vendr) UI uploads work fine.

5) Admins / Contacts: vendor-admin@redwood.com (primary upload/admin), aditya_rao@redwood.com (technical contact for S3 keys), marcus_lin@redwood.com (security contact).

Next steps: If you confirm Vendr and the proposed cadence, I'll attach a CSV (matrix) with field-level owners and a short onboarding doc with the steps we follow so procurement can finalize the PO. If Vendr requires a signed access request or an NDA, please loop procurement and we'll sign.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Security (Acting)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: responsibility_matrix_v1.csv (CSV, 6KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_onboarding_instructions.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Leah Park <leah.park@acme-payments.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding request: Vendr/Whistic + evidence responsibilities

Vanessa — thanks, that is helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we kick off Vendr: 

- For CAIQ field ownership: do you expect Security to draft the written answers and Platform to upload artifacts, or do you want us to create the CAIQ template in Vendr and assign fields to each contact?
- Our security team typically wants proof-of-possession for KMS keys (signed public key metadata) and a small sample of syslog for verification. Are you able to provide a redacted syslog extract and a KMS key metadata snapshot?
- The procurement team asked whether Redwood can accept a 30-day evidence refresh SLA for 'operational infra items' — that is stricter than your 90-day suggestion. Is there any evidence that you can commit to at 30-day cadence (token rotation proof, ephemeral credential TTL confirmation)?

Also: can you provide the preferred contact for portal role 'Owner' vs 'Evidence Submitter' so we can map them inside Vendr?

Leah

Subject: Re: Portal onboarding request: Vendr/Whistic + evidence responsibilities

Leah / procurement team —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Short answers and a proposed field-level mapping (see attached CSV):

- CAIQ ownership workflow: Security will draft the narrative for control intent and map controls to evidence. Platform will upload required artifacts and export metadata (file hashes, timestamps). For Vendr, we can pre-populate a template and assign fields: Owner = "Security" (for narrative), Evidence Submitter = "Platform" (for artifacts). That mapping makes review workflows in Vendr explicit and reduces back-and-forth.

- Proof samples: we can provide a redacted 7-day syslog extract (redaction applied), and a KMS metadata snapshot that includes key id, creation date, and last-rotation timestamp. Those will be uploaded via S3 presigned link.

- SLA compromise: We're comfortable committing to a 30-day refresh for short-lived items (ephemeral credential TTL confirmations, token rotation logs) and to a 90-day cadence for most operational snapshots. SOC 2 remains annual. We'll flag anything that requires an ad-hoc refresh.

Proposed onboarding schedule:
  - Today: you create the Vendr record and invite vendor-admin@redwood.com.
  - Tue 31 Aug 2027 @ 11:00am PT: 30-minute handoff call (we'll triage which CAIQ fields require evidence and confirm S3 upload flow).

Action items for you: confirm Vendr invite and add vendor-admin@redwood.com as "Owner" and aditya_rao@redwood.com as "Evidence Submitter" for technical artifacts.

I'll also drop a Confluence page with the field-level mapping and the presigned S3 instructions here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/ONBOARD-8472 (internal).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Security (Acting)
Redwood Inference
